description:
All hired employees are expected to have experience with Microsoft Copilot and / or an approved equivalent AI solution. 

 Description: 

 
Data Systems Analysts, Inc. (DSA) is seeking a Power Platform Developer to join a high-performing team supporting an Army customer. This position requires a DOD Secret Clearance. This Power Platform Developer will work as part of a team that develops and delivers Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and data visualization solutions to the government customer.This role provides Power Platform Developer support to a dynamic organization supporting the Army. The government customer team works in partnership with the DSA team and subcontractors to provide a cohesive support model to a varied customer base. Team members are respected and recognized for their role on the team. There is potential for professional development and career growth for motivated candidates.



 Required Qualifications 

 
 Active Secret Clearance

 Customer engagement experience, ability to develop relationships and understand customer needs

 3-5 years Power Apps development and delivery experience 

 1-5 years of Power Automate experience focusing on business process automation

 Advanced SharePoint Online (SPO) experience with proven understanding of how SharePoint fits into the ecosystem of M365

 Foundational knowledge (with some experience) in Power Pages, Dataverse, Premium Capacities

 Understanding of UX/UI principles

 Intermediate to Advanced experience and understanding of Microsoft 365 suite of tools

 Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

 Ability to complete tasks with little to no supervision

 COMPTIA Security + certification (Certification preferred upon hire but must be acquired within 90 days for otherwise well qualified candidate)

 Computing Environment (CE) relative to the position (EX: Microsoft Power Platform 100, 200, or 400 other related certifications can be considered) - Certification preferred upon hire but can be acquired within 90 days for otherwise well qualified candidate)

 
 
 Desired Qualifications 

 
 Experience building model driven applications in Power Apps

 Data Architecture experience

 Experience supporting and interacting with Senior Leaders or Executive level

 Understanding of Power BI Premium Workspaces

 Ability to work with ambiguous and/or limited requirements

 Self-motivated, detail-oriented, flexible, and receptive to constructive feedback

 PowerBI Development experience

 Understanding of data visualization solutions and data modeling

 
 Key Responsibilities 

 
 Support development and delivery of data visualizations, Power Apps, Power BI and Power Automate solutions

 Direct engagement with customers to define project requirements and manage customer expectations

 Design, build, and maintain model-driven/canvas Power Apps to support and enhance program and organization operations.

 Design and maintain automated workflows and business process integrations using Power

 Automate to enhance organizational efficiency and connectivity.

 Author and contribute to technical documentation

 Author and deliver reference and training resources

 Customer engagement

 Requirements, definition and documentation

 User acceptance testing (UAT)

 Manage project details and schedule and provide project status updates

 
  

 #DSA209

 #LI-CW1

  
 The posted salary range is a good-faith estimate. Actual compensation will be based on the selected candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and other job-related factors. 
 

 DSA - Salary Pay Range
 $110,000 — $124,700 USD 


 Many of DSA's positions require the ability to obtain a security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens. In addition, applicants who accept a conditional offer of employment may be subject to government security investigation(s) and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. DSA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. DSA is committed to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity and maintaining a workplace that is free from unlawful discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status. DSA requires background checks , where permitted , by law. DSA is an E-Verify Employer.
